file_decisions.evidence: The existing accessible lightbox test now also verifies a square mobile hero, hidden mobile thumbnail rail, and restored desktop thumbnails.
Generic single choices such as Default are hidden, non-apparel choices use Option or Pack / Volume, and size guides appear only for genuinely sized apparel or footwear.
The page gains mobile gallery behavior, reviewed variant/size-guide rules, safe seller/URL offer metadata, and meaningful product information without placeholder material or care values.
The dirty Store JSON-LD publishes phone and street-address fields without a separate public-contact verification gate. Current store presentation and pagination remain authoritative.
The current utility already supports HEIC/HEIF, extension fallback, createImageBitmap and native-image decoding, explicit WebP verification, 20 MB inputs, and focused regression tests.

presentation_invariants: A single generic variant remains purchasable without a fake customer choice.
Size guides are limited to sized clothing and footwear.
Placeholder material and care values are not rendered as specifications.
The product image lightbox retains keyboard, swipe, focus-return, and scroll-lock behavior.
No public store contact field is added to structured data without verification.
production_claim: No product, store, inventory, order, payment, database, deployment, service, or production state was changed.
